cancellation_memory_scope: Observed actual worker working set reclaimed when birth-bound process exits; excludes OS cache/available-memory recovery and GPU/shared-page guarantees. 100 ms observer resolution.

external_context.other_workload: Concurrent pinned-tool archive download; other desktop applications uncontrolled
external_context.startup_cache: Existing locked Python environments and matching prebuilt native DLL; fresh source checkout and editor import

limitations: Resident sums double-count shared pages. Short-lived processes or peaks between samples may be missed. No GPU or unique physical-memory accounting; no OS memory cap.
method: Windows working set / Linux VmRSS; 100 ms requested sampling
